description: This file defines a class 'JSONStorage' which manages thread-safe operations for storing, loading, appending, updating, and retrieving JSON data from files within a specified directory. It encapsulates common JSON file operations with added logging and error handling.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A thread-safe manager for storing JSON data, supporting loading, saving, appending, and updating records within JSON files.

methods.name: __init__(self, cache_path: Path)
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a given directory path for storing JSON files.

methods.name: Path _get_file_path(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Constructs full Path object for a given filename, ensuring it ends with .json.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] load(self, filename: str)
methods.description: Loads and returns a list of dictionaries from the specified JSON file.

methods.name: bool save(self, filename: str, data: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to the specified JSON file.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append(self, filename: str, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Appends a new item to the JSON file, assigning it an ID and timestamp.

methods.name: bool update(self, filename: str, item_id: int, updates: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates an existing item identified by ID in the JSON file with new data.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(self, filename: str, item_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a single item by its ID from the JSON file.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] filter(self, filename: str, **filters)
methods.description: Filters items in the JSON file by given key-value criteria.
